description: This Java source file defines the 'COBExecutionListenerRunner' class, which implements the 'JobExecutionListener' interface to manage pre- and post-job execution listeners for batch jobs within the Fineract system's calendar of batch processing.

classes.name: COBExecutionListenerRunner
classes.description: A class that manages and runs before and after job listeners for batch job executions based on application context and job name.

methods.name: COBExecutionListenerRunner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener runner with application context and job name, setting up relevant listeners.

methods.name: beforeJob
methods.description: Invokes all registered 'before' listeners prior to job execution.

methods.name: afterJob
methods.description: Invokes all registered 'after' listeners following job execution.

methods.name: addAfterListeners
methods.description: Adds 'after' job listeners from the application context that match the specified job name.

methods.name: addBeforeListeners
methods.description: Adds 'before' job listeners from the application context that match the specified job name.
